title.narrative: Developing the water source of Qashaib village in Hadibu district, Socotra Governorate

description.narrative: Construction of a surface water tank, and extension of a pipe from the water source to the tank with a length of 6300 meters, so that about (300) beneficiaries will benefit from the project.
Contributing to improving water provision and quality in Qashayeb village, Socotra Governorate, and enhancing sustainability and effectiveness in providing water to the local community

Given the need of the population in Qashab village in Hadibu district, Socotra governorate, for water, and given the availability of a natural water source (springs), this project aims to improve the chances of the population obtaining sufficient quantities of water by establishing a water collection tank with a 6,300-meter-long drainage network. The project will improve the availability and quality of water in the project intervention areas, and enhance sustainability and effectiveness in providing water to the local community. The project will be implemented over a period of four months, during which all civil works will be carried out to establish the tank and extend the network.
